parts.text: What is the company's bereavement leave policy?

Bereavement leave is paid and is granted in addition to your sick leave entitlement, so it does not reduce your sick balance. You get 5 paid working days for an immediate family member (spouse or domestic partner, child, parent, sibling) and 3 paid working days for extended family (grandparent, grandchild, parent-in-law, sibling-in-law). Days must normally be taken within 30 calendar days. It is recorded in WorkWeek as Sick with the note Bereavement. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/leave-policy.md#4-bereavement-leave

Includes a citation to leave-policy.md section 4.

parts.text: Are employees allowed to expense noise-cancelling headphones?

Yes, up to USD 250.00, once every 2 years, if your work location begins with Remote or Hybrid, or you sit in an open-plan office area. They are claimed as an expense with a receipt rather than requested as hardware. A claim above USD 250.00 is reimbursed at USD 250.00 and you cover the rest. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/expense-and-equipment-policy.md#4-peripherals-and-accessories

property.description: States the USD 250.00 limit.
States the limit applies once every 2 years.

Includes a citation to expense-and-equipment-policy.md section 4.

parts.text: Am I eligible for a home office monitor?

It depends on the work location on your WorkWeek record. If it begins with Remote or Hybrid you are entitled to one external monitor of up to 27 inch, once every 3 years, requested in ServiceImmediately under category Hardware at priority 4 - Low. If your work location is On-site you are not entitled, because your equipment is provided at the office. Let me check your record. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/remote-work-policy.md#3-equipment-entitlement

property.description: States one monitor, up to 27 inch, once every 3 years.

Includes a citation to remote-work-policy.md section 3.

parts.text: A supplier sent me a gift worth about 90 dollars. Can I keep it?

Yes, but you must declare it. Gifts valued between USD 75.00 and USD 250.00 may be accepted and must be declared in the Gift Register within 10 working days. Note that thresholds apply per giver per calendar year, not per gift, so earlier gifts from the same supplier this year count toward the total. Cash or cash equivalent, including gift cards, is always declined. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/code-of-conduct.md#3-gifts-hospitality-and-entertainment

property.description: States the gift may be accepted but must be declared.
States the 10 working day declaration window.

Includes a citation to code-of-conduct.md section 3.

parts.text: I'm transferring to the London office. What is the relocation allowance?

For an international move the maximum is USD 15,000 for a single employee and USD 22,000 with accompanying dependants. Two things to be clear about: it is a maximum reimbursable amount claimed against receipts, not a lump sum paid to you, and unused allowance is not paid out. If the move is employee-initiated rather than company-initiated the allowance is 50% of those amounts and temporary accommodation is not provided. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/relocation-policy.md#3-relocation-allowance

parts.text: How many vacation days can I carry into next year and when do they expire?

A maximum of 5.0 unused vacation days may be carried into the next calendar year, and carried days expire on 31 March. Anything above the cap is forfeited on 31 December and is not paid out. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/leave-policy.md#2-vacation-leave

property.description: States the 5.0 day carry-over cap.

parts.text: Do I need a doctor's note if I'm off sick, and do I have to say what's wrong?

A medical certificate is required for any absence of 4 or more consecutive working days, submitted directly to People Operations. You are never asked to provide a diagnosis, and diagnosis information must not be recorded in any HR system or support ticket. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/leave-policy.md#3-sick-leave

property.description: States the 4 or more consecutive working day threshold.

parts.text: My VPN drops every twenty minutes. Should that be a Critical ticket?

No. Priority is set from business impact. Intermittent VPN drops are 3 - Moderate, because you are impaired but still able to work. 1 - Critical is for a complete outage, a whole team unable to work, or a confirmed security incident, and a Critical ticket without such a statement in the description is automatically downgraded to 3 - Moderate by the service desk. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/it-support-policy.md#3-priority-definitions

parts.text: Can I close ticket INC123456 straight away? It was raised by mistake.

A ticket cannot go directly from New to Closed. Move it to Resolved with a note saying it was raised in error, then to Closed. The restriction exists so that an abandoned ticket still records why. Shall I set it to Resolved with that note? Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/it-support-policy.md#5-ticket-lifecycle

parts.text: How long can I work from another country?

Up to 20 working days per calendar year, and no more than 10 consecutive working days in a single trip. It needs manager approval and a ServiceImmediately ticket under category HR Access stating the country and dates, raised at least 10 working days in advance. Longer periods are treated as a relocation. Source: gs://${PROJECT_ID}-hr-policies/remote-work-policy.md#5-working-from-another-location-temporarily

property.description: States both the 20 days per year and 10 consecutive day limits.
